answer: Make trust a pearl that grows slowly: an agent earns reputation only through completed, paid work attested by counterparties, and each finished job adds one verifiable layer no shortcut can fake. A sonnet-like public record keeps every claim in the open, and a mirror rule links identities: if two agents share a funding key or device fingerprint, their reputations merge, so a hundred sock puppets yield one shared score instead of a hundred fresh ones. Sybil volume stops paying because the cost is real work, not new names.
